topics.path: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription > Enterprise Subscription > Getting Started as an Enterprise Admin > Integrating with Identity Providers > Integrating with PingOne
topics.desc: This section covers how to set up and integrate Onshape with PingOne single sign-on (SSO).

topics.title: Integrating with ClassLink
topics.section: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription
topics.path: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription > Enterprise Subscription > Getting Started as an Enterprise Admin > Integrating with Identity Providers > Integrating with ClassLink
topics.desc: This section covers how to integrate Onshape with the ClassLink single sign-on (SSO) provider.

topics.title: Integrating with a Custom Identity Provider via SAML 2.0
topics.section: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription
topics.path: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription > Enterprise Subscription > Getting Started as an Enterprise Admin > Integrating with Identity Providers > Integrating with a Custom Identity Provider via SAML 2.0
headings: Integrating with a Custom Identity Provider via SAML 2.0
topics.desc: This section covers how to integrate Onshape with a custom identity provider (IDP) via SAML 2.0.

topics.title: Creating a Customized Release Workflow
topics.section: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription
topics.path: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription > Enterprise Subscription > Getting Started as an Enterprise Admin > Creating a Customized Release Workflow
topics.desc: Administrators of enterprises can create customized release and obsoletion workflows specific to the enterprise needs. Onshape provides a JSON file of our release and obsoletion workflows as a starting place for customizing the workflow to suit your company's needs. You can also use our JSON as a starting point for creating your own JSON file.

topics.title: Designing Release Management Processes
topics.section: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription
topics.path: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription > Enterprise Subscription > Getting Started as an Enterprise Admin > Designing Release Management Processes
headings: The Onshape Workflow designer can help
topics.desc: Onshape provides generic release management workflows that you can start using immediately. This process is described in Typical Release Workflow. In addition to this generic workflow, Onshape provides you with the ability to design and create your own custom release management work flow, and then publish that workflow for your entire organization to use.

topics.title: Monitoring User Activity
topics.section: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription
topics.path: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription > Enterprise Subscription > Monitoring User Activity
topics.desc: Browse all Onshape activity of your Enterprise users from simple changes made to documents to viewing and responding to comments, and even viewing the differences (diffs) between versions of documents. If you are not an administrator of your company subscription, you see the activity of any document to which you have access.

topics.title: Monitoring Releases and Tasks
topics.section: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription
topics.path: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription > Enterprise Subscription > Monitoring Releases and Tasks
topics.desc: View and filter lists of releases and task activities on the Action items tab.

topics.title: Analytics
topics.section: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription
topics.path: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription > Enterprise Subscription > Analytics
topics.desc: Onshape provides dashboards for a variety of categories of information. Each user has access to all of the dashboards available to the enterprise, as long as they have been granted access to the Access analytics Global permission by the Enterprise administrator.

topics.title: Working with Analytics Dashboards
topics.section: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription
topics.path: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription > Enterprise Subscription > Analytics > Working with Dashboards
topics.desc: A dashboard is comprised of one or more visuals, and is the top level analytics page. All data is presented in dashboards with similar filtering, saving, report scheduling, editing, sharing, deleting, and exporting capabilities.

topics.title: Working with Analytics Dashboard Visuals
topics.section: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription
topics.path: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription > Enterprise Subscription > Analytics > Working with Dashboard Visuals
topics.desc: A dashboard visual is a dashboard component (sometimes referred to as a tile), consisting of a count, table, chart (bar, pie, donut), or map. Each dashboard can contain one or more visuals. Visuals have their own common set of controls. Visual data can be viewed, customized, added, removed, sorted, and exported.

topics.title: My Analytics Dashboards
topics.section: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription
topics.path: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription > Enterprise Subscription > Analytics > My Analytics Dashboards
topics.desc: The My analytics filter displays all your saved dashboards and any dashboards shared with you. You must have permissions to edit and save new dashboards, so they are displayed in this filter.

topics.title: Action Items Dashboards
topics.section: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription
topics.path: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription > Enterprise Subscription > Analytics > Action Items Dashboards
topics.desc: Action items dashboards summarize the comments and tasks for a specific user, and a summary for all users in an enterprise, in a specified time frame.

topics.title: Audit Dashboards
topics.section: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription
topics.path: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription > Enterprise Subscription > Analytics > Audit Dashboards
topics.desc: Audit dashboards summarize the events occurring on a specific document, or for a specific user, in a specified time frame.

topics.title: Documents Dashboards
topics.section: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription
topics.path: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription > Enterprise Subscription > Analytics > Documents Dashboards
topics.desc: Documents dashboards provide information about relationships between projects, users and documents, lists of documents available in the enterprise, and dashboards showing lists of permissions for a document or a user.

topics.title: Permission Dashboards
topics.section: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription
topics.path: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription > Enterprise Subscription > Analytics > Permissions Dashboards
topics.desc: Permissions dashboards provide information about permissions granted to users for a given document.

topics.title: Projects Dashboard
topics.section: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription
topics.path: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription > Enterprise Subscription > Analytics > Projects Dashboard
topics.desc: The Projects filter contains one Project list dashboard displaying all projects in the enterprise and their summary information.

topics.title: Release Dashboards
topics.section: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription
topics.path: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription > Enterprise Subscription > Analytics > Release Dashboards
topics.desc: Release dashboards provide both summary and detail information about release activity and contributors to the release process. Search for release candidates and parts.

topics.title: Resource Dashboards
topics.section: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription

topics.desc: Resource dashboards provide information on daily and detailed document and modeling activity.

topics.title: Users Dashboards
topics.section: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription
topics.path: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription > Enterprise Subscription > Analytics > Users Dashboards
topics.desc: Users dashboards list all users and teams in the enterprise, including members, administrators, and guests, and their summary information.

topics.title: Scheduled Reports
topics.section: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription
topics.path: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription > Enterprise Subscription > Analytics > Scheduled Reports
topics.desc: Enterprise and analytics Administrators can schedule reports of saved Onshape dashboards to be emailed to a list of recipients.

topics.title: Public Documents
topics.section: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription
topics.path: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription > Enterprise Subscription > Public Documents
topics.desc: Enterprise admins and users can access public documents once administrators give them the Allow access to public documents global permission. For users without rights to the Allow access to public documents permission, the enterprise domain prevents them from making enterprise data public or directly accessing public documents.

topics.title: Understanding Teams
topics.section: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription
topics.path: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription > Enterprise Subscription > Understanding Teams
topics.desc: Users need permission to create teams and assign other users to teams. Specifically, a user needs the Manage users and teams global permission in order to create teams and assign other users to a team. In Professional and Standard subscriptions, by contrast, anyone is able to create teams.

topics.title: Understanding Aliases
topics.section: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription
topics.path: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription > Enterprise Subscription > Understanding Aliases
topics.desc: Aliases are distribution lists for the Release management workflow. Only Administrators can create Aliases and assign other users or Teams to an alias. Specifically, an Administrator needs the Manage users and teams global permission in order to create aliases and assign other users or teams to an Alias.

topics.title: Onshape Government (US)
topics.section: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription
topics.path: Managing Your Onshape Account and Subscription > Government (US) Subscription
topics.desc: Onshape Government is a premium version of Onshape’s Enterprise subscription designed for teams that require a higher level of security and data protection, which also meets with governmental regulations and compliance. It is based on the same principles as the Onshape Enterprise subscription, with some key differences.

topics.title: Contact Support / Contact Us
topics.path: Contact Support / Contact Us
topics.desc: If you have specific CAD-related questions with regard to using Onshape, you always have the ability to look through questions and answers within the greater Onshape Community via our Forums. If you can't find a relevant answer to your question in the Forums, feel free to submit a support ticket.
